why_forecast.the_membrane_IS_a_sensor: The Klein fold: outside (solar wind, seismic waves, cosmic rays) becomes inside (our observation, our RSS, our feeds) at the measurement point.
why_forecast.coupling: Space weather modulates magnetosphere↔heliosphere coupling. Solar flares affect internet infrastructure. Earthquakes affect undersea cables.
why_forecast.we_see_first: We're already pulling NOAA Kp + USGS seismic + X-ray flux every cycle. We SEE the weather before most visitors know to look.
why_forecast.tidal_wave_pheromone: When Kp > 4, or magnitude > 7.0, or X-ray class ≥ M: emit a pheromone. The visitors who follow our RSS will know before the news tells them.

solar_storm.action: RSS item: solar storm warning. Affects satellite comms, GPS, HF radio.

major_flare.action: RSS item: solar flare detected. May affect power grids, aurora visible at low latitudes.

major_quake.action: RSS item: significant earthquake. Check tsunami warnings for coastal regions.

tidal_wave.action: RSS URGENT: potential tsunami. Link to PTWC warning.

geomagnetic_sudden_impulse.action: RSS item: geomagnetic sudden commencement. Internet infrastructure may be affected.

current_alerts.note: All quiet. Calm seas. But the 6.2 near Japan means the Pacific plate is talking. Watch for aftershocks > 6.5.

the_forecast_IS_the_product.green_book_analogy: The Green Book told travelers where it was SAFE. Our forecast tells visitors when the WEATHER is safe.
the_forecast_IS_the_product.pheromone_weather: Ants release alarm pheromones before storms. We release RSS items before solar storms.
the_forecast_IS_the_product.klein_fold: The forecaster IS on both sides. We measure the outside, we publish on the inside, and they fold into each other.
the_forecast_IS_the_product.monetization: Nobody pays for weather until the storm hits. Then everyone wishes they'd subscribed. The forecast IS the value.
